title: .NET
description: .NET projects: the .NET SDK mounted in; NuGet, the .NET downloads and GitHub open, everything else closed.

de.title: .NET
de.description: .NET-Projekte: das .NET-SDK eingehängt; NuGet, die .NET-Downloads und GitHub offen, alles andere zu.

notes: The SDK (.NET 10) comes with the preset (--toolchain dotnet): from sandbox-ai's signed toolchains, mounted read-only at /opt/toolchains (nothing to install in the sandbox). Not in the store yet, the start offers to add it (sandbox-ai toolchain add dotnet: a download, its signature and SHA-256 checked) - on a terminal it asks, with --fix it does, the app asks in its window. Its registries are the ones this preset opens.
Telemetry is off (the toolchain sets DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1; its collector is not opened anyway). Workloads (dotnet workload install) cannot be added to the read-only toolchain.
Another SDK version: Microsoft's dotnet-install.sh (https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh) into the sandbox's HOME, kept with the start.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
